query: EXPLAIN MATCH (s:V01)-[r:BOUNDARY_PARTICIPANT]->(e:V01) RETURN s.uid AS space,e.uid AS participant,r.uid AS relationshipUid,r.localRangesJson AS localRanges,r.localNetLengthM AS localLengthM,r.analysisSliceZM AS sliceZM,r.localGeometryVersion AS version,r.assertionSourceUid AS sourceUid,r.assertionLocator AS sourceLocator ORDER BY space,participant
